classification.difficultyReason: Name each point, line, segment or ray from its endpoint and arrow conventions.

spec.description: A single point with italic T immediately to its right.
spec.mathematics: One labelled point; no lines or arrows.
spec.answerVisibility: The point label is visible; the supplied object name belongs only in answers.

answer.worked: A single labelled dot represents point T.

spec.description: A shallow rising line with arrows beyond C and D; both labels above their points.
spec.mathematics: A line through C and D extends in both directions.
spec.answerVisibility: Point labels and both arrowheads are visible; the object name is answer-only.

answer.worked: Arrowheads at both ends show a line extending forever in both directions. It is line CD or DC.

spec.description: Ray rising from P through Q, with an arrow beyond Q and labels below-right.
spec.mathematics: P is the endpoint; extension is through Q.
spec.answerVisibility: Point labels and the arrowhead are visible; the ray name is answer-only.

answer.worked: The ray starts at P and extends through Q. Name the endpoint first: ray PQ.

spec.description: Ray rising from B through A, with an arrow beyond A. B is labelled left and A right.
spec.mathematics: B is the endpoint; extension is through A.
spec.answerVisibility: Point labels and the arrowhead are visible; the ray name is answer-only.

answer.worked: The endpoint is B and the ray extends through A, so it is ray BA.

spec.description: Segment descending from S at upper left to T at lower right, without arrows.
spec.mathematics: S and T are the two endpoints.
spec.answerVisibility: Endpoint labels are visible; the object name is answer-only.

answer.worked: Two endpoints joined without arrowheads form an interval or line segment. It is interval ST or TS.

spec.description: Segment rising from A to B without arrows; A labelled right and B left.
spec.mathematics: A and B are the two endpoints.
spec.answerVisibility: Endpoint labels are visible; the object name is answer-only.

answer.worked: The figure joins endpoints A and B without arrows. It is interval AB or BA, also called a line segment.
